output.objection: You are missing the point when you treat this as a one off request for a single weather variable. I need the harness to automatically test the entire seasonal feature set so I can iterate on the northern region's demand shifts without waiting for manual validation.
output.correction: Stop misreading my ask as a simple data pipeline fix for one specific feed. I am asking for a rigorous evaluation framework that lets me test and version new model features end to end, which is what actually drives the accuracy improvements you need.
